qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the injection nozzle combination assembly?
What torque should be applied when connecting the injection nozzle combination to the cylinder head?
What are the two different torque specifications listed for the injection nozzle combination to cylinder head?
qa_pairs.answer: 40 Nm for M21 screws and 65 Nm for M51/M41 screws.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification is used for the injection pipe coupling nut to injection pump and nozzle combination?
What is the torque value for the feed line on injection panel?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the fuel injection nozzles and pipes section?
qa_pairs.answer: The injection nozzle combination assembly at 80 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection does this torque specification table cover?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 13-6 Fuel metering and regulation system, subsection 13 53 Fuel Injection Nozzles and Pipes.

qa_pairs.question: What screw type is specified for the M51/M41 injection nozzle combination to cylinder head connection?
qa_pairs.answer: M51/M41 type screws with 65 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are listed for fuel injection components on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: Five different torque specifications: 80 Nm, 40 Nm, 65 Nm, 20 Nm (twice for different applications).
